topics.title: Dice Disputes and a Hypnotized Jessica Hahn
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio show segment featuring Richard Lewis, Sam, and Howard, callers discuss bizarre situations including dice-related disputes, attempts to involve everyone in minor conflicts, and an unsettling experience with Arsenio Hall at MTV. The conversation veers into discussions about hypnosis and an awkward encounter with Jessica Hahn who was hypnotized.

topics.summary: Howard recounts a disastrous typing test that led to his job loss, followed by an enthusiastic discussion about recruiting topless ball girls for the upcoming tennis tournament and plans to hypnotize them.

topics.title: Stern Auditions and Bare Bottoms
topics.summary: During an audition for the National Coliseum’s Home Improvement & Energy Expo, Howard Stern conducts awkward interviews with potential ball girls. The session devolves into a series of uncomfortable exchanges involving personal questions about breasts, missing teeth, past relationships, and requests for hypnosis, culminating in several women taking off their tops.

topics.title: Howard’s Ongoing Ball Boy Confusion
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard repeatedly misunderstands discussions about potential ball boys at an event, leading to chaotic and humorous arguments with Robin and Gary regarding ticket sales and attendee behavior, including bizarre requests for a shirtless performance.

topics.title: Radio Show Ticket Mania and Absurd Conversations
topics.summary: A chaotic radio show features a persistent caller obsessed with concert tickets, bizarre conversations involving requests for revealing attire, and attempts to secure VIP access. Multiple phone numbers are repeatedly announced alongside discussions about celebrity appearances like Dr. Marshall King and a remade version of Silverstein, amidst interruptions and unusual demands.

topics.title: Telephone Chaos and Coliseum Dreams
topics.summary: The broadcast devolves into a chaotic mix of bizarre phone calls, outlandish claims about concert tickets, oil wrestling arenas, and personal grievances. Listeners discuss stolen credit cards, celebrity crushes, and attempts to influence a tennis match against Robin, culminating in promises of a disastrous Coliseum event featuring nude ball girls.
